name: Rising
audio: a crack of thunder, crackling electricity and a rising orchestral hit; no speech
world: The plateau is alive: black thunderheads boil, forks of lightning flicker, rain and static drift sideways, great eagles ride the storm and sparks jump between the standing stones.

actions.beat: Black thunderheads boil above the plateau and forks of lightning flicker across the sky, great eagles riding the storm.
A bolt strikes the crater and {{she}} is hurled upright on the flash of lightning, one arm flung high, hair and ribbons blasted upward.

Lightning arcs away from {{her}} across the plain as shattered rock falls back, static crackling over {{her}} skin and {{her}} eyes blazing with {{MAGIC}} light as {{she}} turns a thrilled look to the camera.

notes: THE DAWN, in motion: the sister rises from the Sundering in her homeland, the world moving around her.
